items.title: Canada braces for prolonged trade war as counter-tariffs on US take effect
items.description: The tariffs will apply to $20bn worth of American products, jeopardising the stability of the world's largest bilateral trading relationship.

items.title: At least two people dead after Russian strikes on Kyiv
items.description: Air raid alerts and sounds of explosions rang out in Ukraine's capital as Russian forces launched drone strikes early on Tuesday.

items.title: Investigation after female staff at Eiffel Tower replaced by men for religious visit
items.description: The move saw outraged staff walk off the job on Monday, closing the French landmark for a day.

items.title: Highest paid world leader to get salary increase of $1 million
items.description: Singapore's prime minister Lawrence Wong will see his annual pay rise to 3.6 million Singapore dollars ($2.8m; £2.1m).

items.title: Argentina targets oil company operating in Falklands
items.description: The move comes days after President Javier Milei stepped up Argentina's claims of sovereignty over the Falklands.

items.title: Five killed in Miami plane crash were in two vehicles on ground, investigators say
items.description: Investigators described the scene as "utter devastation" after a Boeing 767-300 overshot the runway at Miami airport.

items.title: Trial over alleged murders of Australian surfer brothers starts in Mexico
items.description: The bodies of Jake and Callum Robinson and their US friend were found with gunshot wounds to their heads.

items.title: Nepal cracks down on online abuse of flood survivors
items.description: Authorities will "show no leniency" to people who "belittle" those who are suffering, the prime minister says.

items.title: North Korea and Russia open first road bridge linking both countries
items.description: Relations between the neighbours have strengthened since the start of the Ukraine war.

items.title: Kenya moves to register frightened Burundians as tension over foreign traders rises
items.description: All foreigners without proper documents in Kenya are urged to  register through their embassies.

items.title: Trump threatens to stop sale of Canadian Bombardier jets in US
items.description: The threat against one of Canada's largest companies comes amid an escalating trade war between the two neighbours.

items.title: Ukraine's chief prosecutor resigns over call centre corruption scandal
items.description: In his resignation letter, Ruslan Kravchenko denied the allegations against him, saying he did not want his office "to be used as a tool in political confrontation".
